MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Robert Blair, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56241  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, August 14, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56243  Recommendation to receive and file a concession status report regarding “Monty’s
  Dog Beach & Bar” located at 5000 E. Ocean Blvd., Long Beach, CA 90803.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56242  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Public Works on the Long
  Beach E-scooter pilot program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56246  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to the Mayor
  and City Council regarding the escalating debris problem affecting Long Beach's
  coastline due to runoff from the Los Angeles River.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56247  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56248  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2025
  4900 E. 7TH ST.
  RECREATION PARK COMMUNITY CENTER, 2:30 PM

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
